texts.zh:
[From.Capital.GetName]上的外星文明已经在他们的母星轨道上建成了第一艘星际飞船。不管其性能如何，这些外星人已经做好了加入星系，并成为太空种族中一员的准备。

他们好像成功地翻译了我们的语言，并向我们打开了外交通道。
texts.en:
The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of its first interplanetary vessel in orbit of their homeworld. For better or worse, these aliens are now ready to join the galactic community and must be counted among the galaxy's current spacefaring races.

They appear to have successfully translated our language and have opened diplomatic channels with us.
